scope: Official microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T checkpoint; post-decoder residual-stream A4 direction plus separately coded token RMS. Same frozen WikiText-2 protocol as prior native-BitNet gates.

protocol.gate_rule: codec NLL <= exact-radius NLL + 0.10 and codec NLL < same-run matched Hadamard dynamic A4

interpretation.supported: A 4-bit per-token radial codec preserves the A4 radial/angular advantage under the frozen gate and is the minimum passing cascaded precision among tested values.
interpretation.caution: Several quantized-radius conditions slightly outperform exact-radius reconstruction on this small frozen evaluation. Treat that as a clipping/calibration regularization effect until replicated; do not claim that lower-precision radius is intrinsically superior to exact radius.
interpretation.authorization: Gate005 entry condition is satisfied. Proceed exactly under the preregistered A3/A2 scalar-versus-grouped-VQ protocol; do not reopen A1 unless A2 passes.
